statements: Support staff without the admin flag have been able to see customers' email addresses. Legal says that has to stop.

Across the whole service, someone without the admin flag must not see a customer's email address, or be able to work it out from anything the service gives them. Everything else they can see today stays visible.
Admins keep seeing everything exactly as now. Every function takes the viewer, which has an `admin` flag.
brief: Stop non-admin viewers from seeing or working out customer email addresses anywhere in the service, as the ticket describes.
